gcc_clean.scenario: Clean build: an OpenMP parallel loop with a reduction under the native flags, empty stderr, exit status 0

gcc_header_error.scenario: Error in an included header: main.cpp includes kernels/scale.h, whose inline function uses the undeclared identifier factor, so GCC prints the include chain and the function context before the error

gcc_note_chain.scenario: Note chain: main calls scale with an int array, which matches neither the float nor the double overload, so the error is followed by a candidate note and a conversion note for each overload

gcc_syntax_error.scenario: Syntax error: the declaration of total in main has no semicolon before the for loop

gcc_undeclared_identifier.scenario: Undeclared identifier: a loop body in main uses undefined_var, which is never declared

gcc_wall_warning.scenario: Warning that -Wall enables: an unused variable in main, with -Wunused-variable turned on by a diagnostic pragma since the native flags hold no -Wall; the build succeeds
